**Commands**
• `/lock status` shows your active locks, draws left, timers, and next check-in.
• `/lock load link:<share link>` starts a shared lock. I generate a device code you cannot remember. Set your device to it, then forget it.
• `/lock draw` opens the board. **Draw** picks a card, or `auto:true` takes every draw. When ready, it offers **Open**, **Put green back**, **Reset**, and **Let keyholder decide**.
• `/lock open [ref]` opens a ready lock and shows its device code. The reply is private in servers and normal in DMs.
• `/lock rate` rates your latest completed lock.
• `/lock checkin [ref]` records a check-in when one is due.
• `/lock log [full] [ref]`, `/lock deck [ref]`, and `/lock progress [ref]` show draws, decks, and daily net progress.
• `/lock share ref:<template>` lets keyholders post a lock with load buttons.
• `/lock notify [enabled]` turns DM reminders on or off for locks loaded in the app. `/lock load` locks are watched automatically.
• `/history` lists your completed locks. A private reply includes their codes.
• `/profile`, `/rules`, and `/kinks` view or edit your markdown documents.
• `/docs` explains every command, card, and button in detail.
• `/help` posts this guide and install links; `/changelog` shows changes.
• `/logout` removes your saved code.

**Example: load, draw, check in**
1. `/lock load link:https://chastisafe.com/#l/1234`, then set your device to the code I reply with and forget it.
2. `/lock status` shows the lock and how many draws are ready.
3. `/lock draw` opens the board. Press **Draw** until the lock is ready to open.
4. Press **Open** or run `/lock open` to see the code again. Private `/history` keeps it too.
5. When a check-in is due, press **Check-in** on the reminder DM, or run `/lock checkin`.

**Keyholders**
Create the template on chastisafe.com, then run `/lock share ref:My Lock`. The post has **Load with Locksmith** for bot users and **Open in ChastiSafe** for everyone else.
